  id: github
  technology: HTTPS REST and GraphQL APIs; Git remotes
---

Code host supplying repository identity, permissions, pull requests, reviews, check runs, review threads, releases, and Actions observations. Git pushes target the checkout origin, which can be provider-neutral for some branch and tag operations. The guidance updater also reads published GHA release metadata and raw guidance files from GitHub.
